chunks.text: Advance tax is payable in four instalments when the tax liability for the year exceeds Rs 10,000 after TDS: 15% by 15 June, 45% cumulative by 15 September, 75% cumulative by 15 December, and 100% cumulative by 15 March. Taxpayers under presumptive taxation pay in one instalment by 15 March.

The usual ITR due date for individuals not requiring audit is 31 July. Taxpayers whose accounts require audit file by 31 October. Due dates are fixed each year and can be extended, so verify the date for the current assessment year on the income tax portal.

Interest on delayed GST payment is charged at 18% per annum on the net cash tax, pro rated by days delayed divided by 365. The 24% rate applies only when the notice states section 50(3). This is an estimator input; verify on the GST portal.

title: Advance tax instalments and ITR due dates
